document_title: Process Characterization Plan — Low-pH Viral Inactivation (Step 6)
schema_note: Blocks validate against nlp_reports app/models; parameter_type, document_type, QualityAttribute criticality fields, StudyDesign and DesignSpace are local extensions (see schema_extensions_used).
out_of_schema_notes: The XMuLV criterion for this step is a back-calculated step contribution (cumulative requirement minus the clearance credited to AEX and virus filtration) under the modular ICH Q5A(R2) approach; the claim is to be framed at the worst case of the operating region, not at the set-point mean.
MVM is not inactivated at low pH; the step is credited with enveloped-virus clearance only and no HCP clearance is claimed.
The Plan states classification is an OUTPUT; parameter_type left 'unclassified' here.

process_steps.description: Dedicated viral-clearance step: the Protein A eluate is held at low pH to inactivate enveloped viruses (XMuLV), then neutralized. Sets the cumulative XMuLV clearance and can increase aggregate during the hold; ineffective against the non-enveloped parvovirus model MVM.

source_references.quote: The step brings the Protein A eluate to acid pH, holds it there for a defined time and then neutralises it to the condition at which cation exchange is loaded.
The model will match the commercial step in the pH the pool is titrated to, the temperature it is held at and the time it is held for
The studies will be run in bench-scale hold vessels operated under the same principles as the commercial hold.
Cambridge, MA (Development)
Grafton, WI (Commercial DS)

source_references.quote: XMuLV infectivity will be determined by TCID50 under AMV-3017
aggregate content by SEC-HPLC under AMV-3011
acidic charge variants by icIEF under AMV-3013
The screening design is a full factorial in the 3 multivariate factors

statements.statement_text: PCP-006 defines the process characterization study for the A-Mab low-pH viral inactivation step (Step 6), written before any characterization data exist.

source_references.quote: Deliverables and schedule The deliverable of this plan is the Process Characterization Report for the step, PCR-006.

statements.statement_text: Four process parameters are characterized; inactivation pH, hold time and temperature are the multivariate factors and A-Mab concentration is univariate.

source_references.quote: To measure the effect of inactivation pH, hold time and temperature on the log reduction of XMuLV, on the aggregate content of the neutralised pool and on the acidic charge variant content

statements.statement_text: The study uses a full-factorial screen followed by a face-centred central-composite design on a qualified scale-down hold model.

source_references.quote: All 3 factors will be carried into the response-surface design whatever the screening result.

statements.statement_text: Low-pH inactivation is enveloped-virus specific; the parvovirus claim rests on anion exchange and virus filtration instead.

source_references.quote: Low-pH inactivation, anion exchange and virus filtration each contribute an independent log reduction, and the modular claim is the sum of the three

statements.statement_text: The enveloped-virus acceptance criterion for this step is a back-calculated step contribution, not the cumulative drug-substance requirement.

source_references.quote: The criterion that applies to this step alone is therefore not the cumulative figure but the contribution the step must deliver for the cumulative figure to hold

statements.statement_text: The clearance claim will be framed conservatively, from the worst case of the operating region rather than the mean at the set-point.

source_references.quote: The response-surface model is the predictive model, and it is the only model from which an operating region, a proven acceptable range or a prediction at an untested setting will be derived.

statements.statement_text: The operating region must satisfy every response criterion at the same time, evaluated from the fitted models with the other parameters varying within their normal operating ranges.

source_references.quote: At each of 81 points across the characterization range of the parameter of interest, 2,000 Monte-Carlo draws are taken with the other parameters sampled within their normal operating ranges

statements.statement_text: The pH criterion is two-sided and decisive for this step: its upper edge is set by the log-reduction criterion and its lower edge by the aggregate criterion.

source_references.quote: A parameter whose response crosses its criterion steeply needs tighter control than one whose response approaches it slowly

statements.statement_text: Proven acceptable ranges will be reported in two forms, and the analysis that propagates the other parameters across their normal operating ranges is the reported default.

source_references.quote: Aggregate and acidic charge variant samples will be drawn after neutralisation, because those are the values the cation exchange step receives.

assertions.assertion_text: Cumulative XMuLV clearance acceptance: 16.7–30 log10 (cumulative); the criterion applied to this step is the back-calculated step contribution.

source_references.quote: The drug substance requires a cumulative enveloped virus clearance of at least 16.7 log10 across the train.

assertions.assertion_text: Inactivation pH was ranked for multivariate study on its credible impact on the enveloped-virus inactivation and its potential to interact.

source_references.quote: Inactivation pH was ranked highest because the inactivation rate depends on it most steeply of the three, and because the same acid conditions set how far the antibody is unfolded and therefore how fast aggregate forms during the hold.

assertions.assertion_text: Hold time was ranked for multivariate study on its credible impact on the enveloped-virus inactivation and its potential to interact.

source_references.quote: Hold time and temperature were ranked with it because a longer hold and a warmer hold each raise the log reduction of XMuLV and the aggregate content of the pool together.

assertions.assertion_text: Temperature was ranked for multivariate study on its credible impact on the enveloped-virus inactivation and its potential to interact.

source_references.quote: hold time integrates a rate constant that pH and temperature both set

assertions.assertion_text: A-Mab concentration is expected to affect neither response over a wide range.

source_references.quote: Association is a bimolecular event, so a more concentrated pool aggregates faster, but the concentration of the pool has no part in the inactivation chemistry.
